The '''gaunt''' was a bovine creature native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Byss (Abyssin)/Legends|Byss]]. The meat, hides, [[Milk/Legends|milk]], and [[Bone/Legends|bones]] of the gaunt were used to provide many of the needs of the various [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]] tribes who kept flocks of the creatures and herded them from oasis to oasis across the deserts of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].
